data.finalText:
`golem gate` exited with code 2, so it is red. I changed no files.

Four of the 11 requirements are not held:

| Requirement | Scenario | Margin | Seed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.2: push up to 250 N from behind | 225 N at 180 deg, stride phase 0.088 | -0.183 m | 1984748471 |
| 1.3: push up to 100 N from any direction | 58.5 N at 234 deg, stride phase 0.359 | -0.01 m | 1117610652 |
| 4.2: payload up to 20 kg | 15.5 kg | -0.09 m | 625782408 |
| 6.2: sensor latency up to 100 ms | latency duration 0.05 s | -0.01 m | 2916678175 |

The "Exit Code: 0" line at the bottom of the tool output is the PowerShell wrapper's own status. It comes from the trailing `EXIT=` echo, not from `golem gate`.
